state.describe: The step's state: done, running, todo, failed or blocked.

budget_ms.description: How long the verdict may take, in milliseconds from the turn's arrival. A verdict after it changes nothing on the screen; the journal marks it `late`.

threshold.description: The confidence a topic needs before its window opens, in (0, 1]. A topic's manifest may set its own `threshold`, which wins.

data_wait_ms.description: How long an open window waits for a placeable block before it is withdrawn (journal `no_data`). A topic's manifest may set its own.

also_threshold.description: The confidence the second block (`also`) needs to be placed beside the first.

screen_audience.description: The round of the screen, as a canonical list. A data set or row is shown only when its own `audience_set` covers it (`*`, or every member of this round); empty means the screen shows `*` data only.

work_hint.description: The text of the working hint a window carries until its first block stands.

catalog.description: The block copy of the display catalogue: every block, as `name, props, slots, describe`. Written by `scripts/display_sync.py` and by nothing else, so it declares no default of its own -- the copy in `params` is generated.

description.purpose: The presenter's one decision maker: every turn with text becomes ONE call to `./decide`, a sure verdict opens the topic's window with a working hint and asks the owning app for its data in the same output, and blocks are placed as their data arrives -- each one fully bound and checked against the catalogue copy.
description.use_when: Always, as part of the presenter. It is resident with one child because the order of events is the truth: a turn, its verdict, its data and its deadline are handled one after the other.
description.not_in_scope: It holds nothing that is not in the store beside it: RAM is a cache, and a killed child reads `shows` and `pending` back before it handles the event that woke it. It decides nothing about size or focus -- that is the screen's curator -- and it never sends fetched data or memory to the decider.
